row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: UrbanPiper prices Hub by business scale and order volume via sales, and its help centre's User Access guide has admins invite employees by email who then sign in with a username and password; no SSO or SCIM is documented.
row.notes: Quote-only restaurant online-ordering platform (Hub, Atlas, Prime, Meraki); no public price list, no /pricing page (404). No SCIM, set by absence across the product pages and sitemap, the full help-centre index (llms.txt) and the partner API docs (llms.txt), which cover POS menu/order/store integration only. No SAML/OIDC SSO is documented either: users are invited by email in Atlas Settings > User Access and log in with a username and password. Users are archived, not deleted. Not found in Okta OIN or as an Entra tutorial.

plans.name: Hub (custom)
plans.price_text: Contact sales; priced by business scale and order volume

scim.notes: Set by absence: no help-centre or API-docs page mentions SCIM, SSO or provisioning; users are invited manually.

user_api.notes: The public API is the POS/aggregator partner programme (stores, menus, orders, availability); its documentation index has no user, staff or role endpoints.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited by email from Atlas Settings > User Access, assigned roles, and archived (not deleted) when removed; archiving revokes access and keeps their historical data.
